title: WPSS/46634/1999 of VIKRAM SINGH Vs EXECUTIVE ENGINEER and OTHERS

paras.text:
WPSS 2392/2001
Hon'ble P.C.Verma,J.
Sri Ravi Babulkar, learned counsel for the petitioners.
 Sri H.M.Raturi, learned Standing Counsel for the State/respondents.
The petitioner has an alternative remedy before the Public Services
Tribunal and the petitioner may be relegated to Public Services Tribunal.
Accordingly, the petition is dismissed on the ground of alternative remedy.
The registry is directed to remit the paper book to the Tribunal. The
application for interim relief shall be considered by the Tribunal and shall
decide the case within a period of six months from the date of receipt of
paper book of the case.
 (P.C.Verma,J.)
 11.08.2008
P.Singh
